scope: Local inspection and isolated tests; no production access or real cloud delivery

backendUnit.note: Final run allowed local sockets; sandbox port failures from the first run are excluded

backendIntegration.database: Disposable PostgreSQL 17 with all migrations and restricted runtime role
backendIntegration.providers: Test providers; external Stripe, SES and push delivery disabled
backendIntegration.note: Failures require fixture and product triage; counts are not counts of confirmed product defects

mobileTests.note: Capture harness declares itself an image-generation tool; stale fixtures/goldens are not automatically product regressions

productionDependencies.note: Package counts, not unique CVEs or demonstrated exploitation; advisories must be refreshed before each dependency PR

directedProbes.mfaProbeBoundary: Real persistence, synthetic account, controlled hash verifier to synchronize both readers before either consumes the code
directedProbes.refreshProbeBoundary: Repository-level concurrent updates, not two full HTTP refresh requests
directedProbes.rvtProbeBoundary: Direct runtime-role database write under tenant scope; API authorization bypass not demonstrated
directedProbes.uploadProbeBoundary: Synthetic object owned by the test; not a modification of another user's document
directedProbes.ssrfProbeBoundary: Validation only; no internal network read or public exploit attempted
